title: Hybrid Methods for Robust Tabular Data Imputation
abstract: arXiv:2609.39613v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Missing data are a fundamental challenge in statistical analysis and machine learning, as the choice of imputation method substantially impacts downstream inference. In this work, we propose two hybrid imputation methods called NuclearForest and SoftForest, which combine nuclear-norm-based low-rank initialization using Singular Value Thresholding (SVT) and SoftImpute, respectively, with a non-iterative Random Forest refinement. For the SVT-based component, we further introduce an adaptive step-size rule, prove adaptive step-size bounds, and establish convergence for the corresponding zero-initialized iteration. The low-rank initialization provides a structured warm start that captures the global covariance patterns in the data, while the subsequent Random Forest step recovers residual nonlinear signals encoding local dependencies. translated_title: 面向鲁棒表格数据插补的混合方法
translated_abstract: 缺失数据是统计分析和机器学习中的一项根本性挑战，因为插补方法的选择会显著影响下游推断。在本工作中，我们提出了两种名为NuclearForest和SoftForest的混合插补方法，它们分别将基于核范数的低秩初始化（使用奇异值阈值化SVT和SoftImpute）与非迭代的随机森林细化步骤相结合。对于基于SVT的组件，我们进一步引入了一种自适应步长规则，证明了自适应步长的界限，并建立了相应的零初始化迭代的收敛性。低秩初始化提供了一个结构化的热启动，能够捕捉数据中的全局协方差模式，而随后的随机森林步骤则恢复编码局部依赖关系的残余非线性信号。我们在来自不同应用领域的多样化数据集上进行了广泛的基准测试，比较了所提出的方法……
tldr: 本文提出了两种结合核范数低秩初始化（SVT/SoftImpute）与非迭代随机森林细化的混合插补方法NuclearForest和SoftForest，能够同时捕捉表格数据的全局结构模式和局部非线性依赖关系，实现鲁棒的数据插补。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes two hybrid imputation methods, NuclearForest and SoftForest, which combine nuclear-norm-based low-rank initialization (via SVT and SoftImpute) with non-iterative Random Forest refinement to robustly capture both global structural patterns and local nonlinear dependencies in tabular data.
